ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is an aquatic food web, with no clearly readable text labels; in the center there are producers such as aquatic plants/algae, and around them there are multiple fish and other aquatic organisms, with black arrows connecting them. The predator/carnivore fish in the question can correspond to the larger predatory fish in the image, and in the image there is a feeding arrow from a smaller fish pointing to this larger fish; this smaller fish is also connected with the central plants/producers part, so in this food chain it can be judged to be a herbivore fish that eats plants. Reasoning: By food web convention, arrows point from the food or prey to the organism that eats it. Since the prey arrow pointing to the predator/carnivore fish comes from this herbivore fish, predator carnivore fish feed on herbivore fish.
